item.title: Vodafone axes 3,000 jobs in UK and Europe in cost-cutting drive
item.body: Vodafone is cutting 3,000 jobs in the UK and Europe as part of a cost-cutting drive. It has also revealed plans for a further 2,300 job cuts in Germany to help revive its performance in the country.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📉 Vodafone axes 3,000 jobs in UK and Europe in cost-cutting drive

Vodafone is cutting 3,000 jobs in the UK and Europe as part of a cost-cutting drive. It has also revealed plans for a further 2,300 job cuts in Germany to help revive its performance in the country.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 10 November, 15:50
